_comment: Guided puzzle solutions for FINAL FANTASY IV (src/core/field/puzzle_guide.cpp). Map ids are the map master's (tools/mapdump/ff4_master/map.txt); cells are baked tile coordinates, one row above the dumps' ty for tile objects since the 2026-10-11 bottom-edge fix in bake_maps.py (tools/mapdump/ff4_objects.jsonl). Authored 2026-10-10 from the dumps' developer labels; not yet tested in game.

puzzles._about: Troia Castle B1: the four floor switches are stepped on in order, 1 to 4 (the developers' label: スイッチ（1→2→3→4→終了）). Switches at (2,7) (5,7) (8,7) (11,7), the doors on the row below.
Castle Baron: the two wall switches in the castle at (18,31) and (18,20).
Castle Baron 1F: the switch at (18,9) opens the door at (19,7).
Castle Baron 1F (west): the switch at (18,9) opens the door at (16,7).
Town of Baron, Devil's Road: the switch at (5,11) opens the hidden door at (6,9).
